ko.title: 너무 많은 철강, 너무 많은 패널: 미국이 중국의 과잉 생산에 맞서 동맹국들을 결집하는 이유

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: 워싱턴은 산업 과잉 생산 능력에 관해 14개국과 회담을 소집했으며, 베이징은 공개적으로 반발했습니다.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: 이번 회담은 한때 틈새 무역 용어였던 '과잉 생산'이 주요 경제국들이 서로를 대하는 방식에서 핵심적인 이슈가 되었음을 보여주는 가장 최근의 신호입니다.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: 이 단어가 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 산업이 가장 큰 영향을 받는지, 그리고 이 분쟁이 어떻게 국내 물가와 일자리에 영향을 미칠 수 있는지 알아보겠습니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 하며 투자, 법률 또는 재무 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Details of the talks may change as the situation develops.*
segments.tr: 회담의 세부 사항은 상황 전개에 따라 변경될 수 있습니다.*

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## "과잉 생산"의 실제 의미

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: 과잉 생산은 공장이 수익성 있는 가격으로 시장이 구매하려는 것보다 훨씬 더 많이 생산할 수 있을 때 발생합니다.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: 정상적인 시장에서는 가격 하락, 수익 감소, 그리고 결국 공장 폐쇄나 합병을 통해 그 격차가 해소됩니다.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: 미국의 주장은 중국에서는 이러한 조정이 일반적인 방식으로 일어나지 않는다는 것입니다.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: 워싱턴과 여러 동맹국 수도의 관리들은 저렴한 신용 대출, 보조금을 받는 토지와 에너지, 공장 가동을 유지하기 위한 지방 정부의 인센티브 등 정부 지원이 수요가 부진할 때도 생산자들이 계속 확장할 수 있게 한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: 그렇게 발생한 잉여 물량은 낮은 가격으로 수출 시장에 흘러 들어갑니다.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: 중국은 그러한 프레임을 거부합니다.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: 중국 관리들은 자국 제조업체가 불공정한 지원 때문이 아니라 규모, 공급망의 깊이, 기술력 덕분에 경쟁력이 있다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: 그들은 또한 전 세계적으로 친환경 기술에 대한 수요가 증가하고 있으며, 저렴한 중국 제품이 소비자에게 도움을 주고 에너지 전환을 가속화했다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: 많은 경제학자는 두 견해 사이에서 중립을 지킵니다. 보조금은 실재하며 규모도 크지만, 중국 제조업의 효율성 또한 높다는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## 이 논쟁이 지금 부각되는 이유

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: 여러 가지 추세가 복합적으로 작용했습니다:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **중국의 내수 부진.** 장기간의 부동산 침체로 인해 국내 철강, 시멘트, 유리 수요가 감소하면서 생산자들이 해외로 눈을 돌리게 되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **제조업에 대한 과도한 투자.** 자본이 전기차, 배터리, 태양광 장비 분야로 흘러 들어갔는데, 이는 종종 전 세계 수요 증가 속도보다 빨랐습니다.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **전 세계 가격 하락.** 여러 부문에서 수출 가격이 급격히 하락하여 유럽, 북미, 인도, 동남아시아의 생산자들이 압박을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **공통된 좌절감.** 많은 사안에서 의견이 다른 정부들이 이제 이 문제에 대해서는 공감대를 형성하고 있으며, 이것이 바로 다국적 회담이 가능한 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## 가장 큰 영향을 받는 산업

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **철강 및 알루미늄.** 중국은 전 세계 철강의 약 절반을 생산하며, 이는 다른 어떤 나라보다 훨씬 많은 양입니다.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: 중국의 수출량이 전체 생산량에서 차지하는 비중이 적더라도, 다른 시장의 철강 무역 규모와 비교하면 그 양은 막대합니다.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: 유럽, 일본, 한국, 인도, 미국의 생산자들은 모두 자국 정부에 보호 조치를 요구해 왔습니다.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **태양광 패널.** 중국 기업들은 폴리실리콘부터 완제품 모듈에 이르기까지 태양광 공급망의 거의 모든 단계를 장악하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: 전 세계 제조 능력은 연간 설치량을 훨씬 웃돌고 있으며, 패널 가격은 역사적 최저치로 떨어졌습니다.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: 이는 설치업체와 구매자에게는 좋은 소식이지만, 중국 외의 많은 제조업체를 손실이나 파산으로 몰아넣었습니다.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **전기차 및 배터리.** 중국 자동차 제조업체들은 빠르게 확장해 왔으며, 미국과 EU는 관세와 조사로 대응했습니다.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: 배터리 제조업체들도 생산 능력이 주문량보다 빠르게 증가하면서 같은 압박에 직면해 있습니다.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **화학 제품, 유리 및 기타 기초 소재.** 이 분야는 소비자에게 덜 눈에 띄지만 다른 많은 산업에 원자재를 공급하며, 이곳의 가격 변동은 경제 전반에 파급 효과를 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## 물가에 미칠 수 있는 영향

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 가계 입장에서 상황은 복합적입니다.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **저렴한 수입품은 소비자에게 도움이 됩니다.** 가격이 낮은 패널, 배터리, 가전제품, 차량은 구매자의 비용을 절감하고 청정 에너지 도입을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **무역 장벽은 비용을 상승시킬 수 있습니다.** 미국과 그 파트너들이 더 높은 관세, 쿼터 또는 기타 제한 조치로 대응한다면, 그러한 비용 이점 중 일부는 사라집니다. 과거 철강, 알루미늄 및 특정 중국산 제품에 부과된 관세는 부분적으로 국내 기업이, 간접적으로는 소비자가 부담했습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **보복 가능성이 있습니다.** 중국은 이전에 희토류 및 핵심 광물과 같은 원자재에 대한 수출 통제와 농산물을 포함한 미국산 제품에 대한 자체 관세로 무역 조치에 대응한 적이 있습니다. 이는 해당 원자재에 의존하는 제조업체와 중국 구매자에게 의존하는 농부들에게 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **공급망 보안에는 대가가 따릅니다.** 국내나 동맹국에 생산 능력을 더 많이 구축하는 것은 일반적으로 가장 저렴한 생산자로부터 구매하는 것보다 비용이 더 많이 듭니다. 지지자들은 그 프리미엄이 회복력을 구매하는 것이라고 말하고, 비판자들은 그것이 숨겨진 세금이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## 일자리에 미칠 수 있는 영향

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: 고용에 미치는 영향은 거주 지역과 종사하는 직종에 따라 크게 달라집니다.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **보호받는 산업은 이득을 볼 수 있습니다.** 철강 노동자, 알루미늄 제련소 직원, 국내 태양광 및 배터리 공장 근로자들은 수입 압박이 완화되면 혜택을 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **하류 산업은 손해를 볼 수 있습니다.** 해당 원자재를 구매하는 제조업체, 건설업체, 설치업체는 더 높은 투입 비용에 직면할 수 있으며, 이는 고용이나 투자를 줄이는 결과를 초래할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **수출업체는 보복 위험을 안고 있습니다.** 농장, 항공기 제조업체 및 기타 수출업체는 무역 파트너가 보복할 경우 타격을 입을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **지역적 영향이 가장 중요합니다.** 공장 폐쇄는 특정 마을에 큰 타격을 주지만, 저렴한 수입품의 혜택은 수백만 명의 구매자에게 얇게 퍼집니다. 이러한 불균형이 이 문제가 정치적으로 강력한 이유 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 다음으로 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **회담이 구체적인 행동으로 이어질지 여부.** 공동 성명은 하나의 단계일 뿐이며, 조정된 관세, 공통 무역 방어 규칙 또는 공동 조사는 또 다른 차원의 문제입니다.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **동맹국들이 자국의 이익과 어떻게 균형을 맞출지.** 회담에 초대된 많은 국가들도 중국과 활발히 교역하고 있으며 편을 들고 싶어 하지 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **중국의 대응.** 베이징은 특정 부문의 생산 규율과 같은 제한적인 양보를 제안할 수도 있고, 대응 조치로 맞설 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **글로벌 차원의 규칙.** 보조금과 시장 왜곡에 관한 분쟁은 종종 세계무역기구(WTO)로 넘어가지만, 최근 몇 년간 WTO의 분쟁 해결 시스템은 약화되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: 과잉 생산을 둘러싼 분쟁은 단순히 철강과 태양광 패널에 관한 것 이상입니다.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: 이는 매우 거대한 경제가 대규모로 자국 산업을 지원할 때 개방형 시장이 어떻게 작동해야 하는지, 그리고 다른 지역의 소비자와 노동자들이 자국의 제조업 기반을 보호하기 위해 얼마나 많은 비용을 지불해야 하는지에 대한 논쟁입니다.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: 저렴한 상품으로 얻는 실질적인 이득과 공장 폐쇄로 인한 실질적인 비용이 존재하며, 정책은 이 두 가지를 모두 고려해야 할 것입니다.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: 독자들에게 가장 실질적인 시사점은 철강 기반 제품, 태양광 설치, 차량 및 배터리의 가격과 제조업 지역의 일자리가 이번 협상이 어떻게 전개되느냐에 따라 결정될 가능성이 높다는 것입니다.

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## “产能过剩”的真正含义

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: 当工厂的生产能力远超市场愿意以盈利价格购买的数量时，产能过剩就产生了。

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: 在正常市场中，这种差距会通过价格下跌、利润缩水以及最终的工厂倒闭或合并来弥补。

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: 美国的论点是，这种修正并没有在中国以寻常的方式发生。

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: 华盛顿和几个盟国首都的官员表示，政府的支持（包括廉价信贷、补贴土地和能源，以及地方政府维持工厂运转的激励措施）使得生产者即使在需求疲软的情况下也能继续扩张。

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: 然后，这些过剩产品便以低价涌入出口市场。

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: 中国拒绝这种说法。

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: 中国官员认为，他们的制造商之所以具有竞争力，是因为规模、供应链深度和技术，而不是因为不公平的援助。

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: 他们还指出，全球对绿色技术的需求正在增长，廉价的中国产品帮助了消费者并加速了能源转型。

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: 许多经济学家介于这两种观点之间：补贴是真实且巨大的，但中国制造业的效率也是如此。

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## 为什么这一论点现在引发关注

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: 多种趋势汇聚在一起：

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **中国国内需求疲软。** 长期的房地产低迷减少了国内对钢铁、水泥和玻璃的需求，使得生产者不得不将目光投向海外。

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **对制造业的大规模投资。** 资本涌入电动汽车、电池和太阳能设备领域，其速度往往超过了全球需求的增长。

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **全球价格下跌。** 在多个行业中，出口价格大幅下跌，挤压了欧洲、北美、印度和东南亚的生产者。

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **共同的挫败感。** 在许多事情上意见不一的各国政府现在在这一点上找到了共同点，这就是为什么多国会议能够召开的原因。

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## 受冲击最大的行业

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **钢铁和铝。** 中国生产了全球大约一半的钢铁，远超其他任何国家。

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: 即使中国的出口在其产量中只占很小一部分，但相对于其他市场的钢铁贸易而言，它们依然规模庞大。

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: 欧洲、日本、韩国、印度和美国的生产者纷纷向各自政府施压以寻求保护。

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **太阳能面板。** 从多晶硅到成品组件，中国企业主导了太阳能供应链的几乎每一个环节。

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: 全球制造能力远高于每年的装机量，面板价格已跌至历史最低点。

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: 这对安装商和买家来说是个好消息，但它却将中国以外的许多制造商推向了亏损或破产的境地。

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **电动汽车和电池。** 中国汽车制造商迅速扩张，美国和欧盟则以关税和调查作出回应。

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: 电池制造商面临着同样的压力，因为产能的增长速度超过了订单的增长速度。

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **化工、玻璃和其他基础材料。** 这些行业对消费者而言不太显眼，但它们供应了许多其他行业，那里的价格波动可能会在整个经济中产生涟漪效应。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## 这对价格意味着什么

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 对家庭而言，情况是复杂的。

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **更便宜的进口商品帮助了消费者。** 价格更低的面板、电池、家电和汽车降低了买家的成本，并可以加速清洁能源的普及。

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **贸易壁垒可能会推高成本。** 如果美国及其伙伴以更高的关税、配额或其他限制做出回应，其中一部分成本优势就会消失。过去对钢铁、铝和某些中国商品征收的关税，部分是由国内企业支付的，间接上也由消费者承担。

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **报复是有可能的。** 中国过去曾对贸易措施作出回应，对稀土和关键矿产等材料实施出口管制，并对包括农产品在内的美国商品征收自己的关税。这可能会影响依赖这些投入的制造商以及依赖中国买家的农民。

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **供应链安全是有代价的。** 在国内或盟国建立更多的产能，通常比从成本最低的生产者那里购买要花更多的钱。支持者说，这种溢价买来的是韧性；批评者说，这是一种隐性税收。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## 这对就业意味着什么

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: 对就业的影响很大程度上取决于你住在哪里以及你做什么。

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **受保护的行业可能会获益。** 如果进口压力减轻，钢铁工人、铝冶炼厂员工以及国内太阳能和电池工厂的工人将从中受益。

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **下游行业可能会受损。** 购买这些材料的制造商、建筑商和安装商可能会面临更高的投入成本，这可能会减少招聘或投资。

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **出口商承担报复风险。** 如果贸易伙伴进行报复，农场、飞机制造商和其他出口商可能会受到打击。

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **地方影响最为重要。** 工厂关闭给特定的城镇带来了沉重打击，而廉价进口商品的好处则薄薄地分散在数百万买家身上。这种不平衡是该问题在政治上具有强大影响力的一个重要原因。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来需要关注什么

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **会谈是否会产生具体行动。** 共同声明是一回事；协调一致的关税、共同的贸易防御规则或联合调查则是另一回事。

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **盟友如何平衡自身利益。** 许多被邀请参加会谈的国家与中国也有着巨大的贸易往来，可能不愿选边站队。

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **中国的反应。** 北京可能会提供有限的让步，例如在某些行业实行生产纪律，或者以反制措施进行回应。

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **全球层面的规则。** 关于补贴和市场扭曲的争端往往最终会诉诸世界贸易组织，尽管其争端解决机制在近年来已被削弱。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: 围绕产能过剩的争端不仅仅关乎钢铁和太阳能面板。

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: 这是一场关于当一个超大经济体以庞大规模型支持其产业时，开放市场应该如何运作的辩论，也是关于其他地方的消费者和工人应该付出多少代价来保护自身制造业基础的辩论。

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: 廉价商品带来的是真正的收益，工厂倒闭带来的是真正的成本，政策必须权衡这两者。

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: 对于读者来说，最实用的结论是：钢铁制品、太阳能装置、汽车和电池的价格，以及制造业地区的就业机会，很可能会由这场谈判的演变方式来决定。

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: यह बैठक इस बात का नवीनतम संकेत है कि अतिरिक्त क्षमता, जो कभी एक विशिष्ट व्यापार शब्द हुआ करता था, इस बात का एक केंद्रीय मुद्दा बन गया है कि प्रमुख अर्थव्यवस्थाएं एक-दूसरे के साथ कैसे व्यवहार करती हैं।

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## "अतिरिक्त क्षमता" (overcapacity) का वास्तव में क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: अतिरिक्त क्षमता तब मौजूद होती है जब कारखाने उससे कहीं अधिक उत्पादन कर सकते हैं जितना बाजार लाभकारी मूल्य पर खरीदने को तैयार है।

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: एक सामान्य बाजार में, वह अंतर गिरते मूल्यों, घटते मुनाफे और अंततः कारखाने के बंद होने या विलय से समाप्त हो जाता है।

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: अमेरिका का तर्क यह है कि चीन में यह सुधार सामान्य तरीके से नहीं होता है।

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: वाशिंगटन और कई मित्र देशों की राजधानियों के अधिकारियों का कहना है कि सरकारी समर्थन, जिसमें सस्ता कर्ज, सब्सिडी वाली जमीन और ऊर्जा, तथा कारखानों को चालू रखने के लिए स्थानीय-सरकार के प्रोत्साहन शामिल हैं, उत्पादकों को कमजोर मांग होने पर भी विस्तार जारी रखने की अनुमति देता है।

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: फिर यह अधिशेष कम कीमतों पर निर्यात बाजारों में प्रवाहित होता है।

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: चीन इस रूपरेखा को खारिज करता है।

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: चीनी अधिकारियों का तर्क है कि उनके निर्माता पैमाने, आपूर्ति-शृंखला की गहराई और प्रौद्योगिकी के कारण प्रतिस्पर्धी हैं, न कि अनुचित मदद के कारण।

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: वे यह भी बताते हैं कि दुनिया भर में हरित प्रौद्योगिकी की मांग बढ़ रही है, और सस्ते चीनी उत्पादों ने उपभोक्ताओं की मदद की है और ऊर्जा परिवर्तन में तेजी लाई है।

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: कई अर्थशास्त्री दोनों विचारों के बीच में हैं: सब्सिडी वास्तविक और बड़ी हैं, लेकिन चीनी विनिर्माण दक्षता भी उतनी ही बड़ी है।

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## यह बहस अभी क्यों सामने आ रही है

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: कई रुझान एक साथ आए हैं:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **चीन में कमजोर घरेलू मांग।** एक लंबी संपत्ति मंदी ने घर में स्टील, सीमेंट और कांच की मांग को कम कर दिया है, जिससे उत्पादकों को विदेश देखने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ा है।

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **विनिर्माण में भारी निवेश।** पूंजी इलेक्ट्रिक वाहनों, बैटरी और सौर उपकरणों में प्रवाहित हुई है, अक्सर वैश्विक मांग जितनी बढ़ी है उससे अधिक तेजी से।

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **गिरती वैश्विक कीमतें।** कई क्षेत्रों में, निर्यात की कीमतें में भारी गिरावट आई है, जिससे यूरोप, उत्तरी अमेरिका, भारत और दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया के उत्पादकों पर दबाव पड़ा है।

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **साझा निराशा।** जो सरकारें कई बातों पर असहमत हैं, वे अब इस बात पर एक आम सहमति पा रही हैं, यही कारण है कि बहु-देशीय बैठक संभव हो पाई है।

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## सबसे अधिक प्रभावित उद्योग

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **स्टील और एल्यूमीनियम।** चीन दुनिया के स्टील का लगभग आधा उत्पादन करता है, जो किसी भी अन्य देश की तुलना में कहीं अधिक है।

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: भले ही चीन का निर्यात उसके उत्पादन का एक मामूली हिस्सा हो, लेकिन अन्य बाजारों के स्टील व्यापार के मुकाबले वे बड़े हैं।

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: यूरोप, जापान, दक्षिण कोरिया, भारत और अमेरिका के उत्पादकों ने सुरक्षा के लिए अपनी सरकारों पर दबाव डाला है।

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **सौर पैनल (Solar panels)।** पॉलीसिलिकॉन से लेकर तैयार मॉड्यूल तक, सौर आपूर्ति शृंखला के लगभग हर चरण पर चीनी फर्मों का दबदबा है।

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: वैश्विक विनिर्माण क्षमता वार्षिक स्थापनाओं से काफी ऊपर है, और पैनल की कीमतें ऐतिहासिक निचले स्तर पर आ गई हैं।

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: यह इंस्टालर और खरीदारों के लिए अच्छी खबर है, लेकिन इसने चीन के बाहर कई निर्माताओं को नुकसान या दिवालियापन में धकेल दिया है।

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन और बैटरी।** चीनी वाहन निर्माताओं ने तेजी से विस्तार किया है, और अमेरिका और यूरोपीय संघ ने टैरिफ और जांच के साथ जवाब दिया है।

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: बैटरी निर्माताओं को भी इसी दबाव का सामना करना पड़ रहा है, क्योंकि क्षमता ऑर्डर की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ी है।

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **रसायन, कांच और अन्य बुनियादी सामग्री।** ये क्षेत्र उपभोक्ताओं के लिए कम दिखाई देते हैं, लेकिन वे कई अन्य उद्योगों की आपूर्ति करते हैं, और वहां मूल्य उतार-चढ़ाव अर्थव्यवस्था के माध्यम से लहर पैदा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## कीमतों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: घरों के लिए, तस्वीर मिली-जुली है।

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **सस्ते आयात उपभोक्ताओं की मदद करते हैं।** कम कीमत वाले पैनल, बैटरी, उपकरण और वाहन खरीदारों के लिए लागत को कम करते हैं और स्वच्छ ऊर्जा को अपनाने में तेजी ला सकते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **व्यापार बाधाएं लागत बढ़ा सकती हैं।** यदि अमेरिका और उसके साझेदार उच्च टैरिफ, कोटा या अन्य प्रतिबंधों के साथ जवाब देते हैं, तो वह लागत लाभ गायब हो जाता है। स्टील, एल्यूमीनियम और कुछ चीनी सामानों पर पिछले टैरिफ का भुगतान आंशिक रूप से घरेलू व्यवसायों द्वारा और अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा किया गया है।

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **प्रतिशोध संभव है।** चीन ने पहले दुर्लभ पृथ्वी और महत्वपूर्ण खनिजों जैसी सामग्रियों पर निर्यात नियंत्रण के साथ, और अमेरिकी वस्तुओं पर अपने स्वयं के टैरिफ के साथ व्यापार उपायों का जवाब दिया है। इससे उन निर्माताओं को असर पड़ सकता है जो उन इनपुट पर निर्भर हैं और उन किसानों को जो चीनी खरीदारों पर भरोसा करते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **आपूर्ति-शृंखला सुरक्षा की एक कीमत होती है।** देश में या मित्र देशों में अधिक क्षमता का निर्माण आमतौर पर सबसे कम लागत वाले उत्पादक से खरीदने की तुलना में अधिक महंगा होता है। समर्थकों का कहना है कि वह प्रीमियम लचीलापन खरीदता है; आलोचकों का कहना है कि यह एक छुपा हुआ कर है।

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## नौकरियों के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ हो सकता है

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: रोजगार पर प्रभाव इस बात पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर करता है कि आप कहाँ रहते हैं और आप क्या करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **संरक्षित उद्योगों को लाभ हो सकता है।** यदि आयात का दबाव कम होता है तो स्टील कर्मचारियों, एल्यूमीनियम स्मेल्टर कर्मचारियों, और घरेलू सौर और बैटरी संयंत्रों के श्रमिकों को लाभ हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **डाउनस्ट्रीम उद्योगों को नुकसान हो सकता है।** निर्माता, निर्माता और इंस्टालर जो उन सामग्रियों को खरीदते हैं, उन्हें उच्च इनपुट लागत का सामना करना पड़ सकता है, जिससे काम पर रखना या निवेश कम हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **निर्यातक प्रतिशोध के जोखिम को उठाते हैं।** यदि व्यापारिक साझेदार जवाबी कार्रवाई करते हैं तो खेतों, विमान निर्माताओं और अन्य निर्यातकों को झटका लग सकता है।

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **स्थानीय प्रभाव सबसे अधिक मायने रखते हैं।** कारखाने के बंद होने से विशिष्ट शहरों पर कड़ी मार पड़ती है, जबकि सस्ते आयात के लाभ लाखों खरीदारों में पतले रूप से फैले होते हैं। यह असंतुलन एक बड़ा कारण है कि यह मुद्दा राजनीतिक रूप से शक्तिशाली है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **क्या बातचीत ठोस कार्रवाई पैदा करती है।** एक साझा बयान एक बात है; समन्वित टैरिफ, सामान्य व्यापार-रक्षा नियम, या संयुक्त जांच कुछ और होगी।

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **सहयोगी अपने स्वयं के हितों को कैसे संतुलित करते हैं।** बात करने के लिए आमंत्रित कई देश चीन के साथ भारी व्यापार भी करते हैं और पक्ष नहीं चुनना चाह सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **चीन की प्रतिक्रिया।** बीजिंग सीमित रियायतें दे सकता है, जैसे कि कुछ क्षेत्रों में उत्पादन अनुशासन, या यह जवाबी उपायों के साथ जवाब दे सकता है।

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **वैश्विक स्तर पर नियम।** सब्सिडी और बाजार विकृतियों पर विवाद अक्सर विश्व व्यापार संगठन में समाप्त होते हैं, हालांकि हाल के वर्षों में इसकी विवाद प्रणाली कमजोर हो गई है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: अतिरिक्त क्षमता पर विवाद केवल स्टील और सौर पैनलों के बारे में नहीं है।

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: यह इस बारे में एक बहस है कि खुले बाजारों को कैसे काम करना चाहिए जब एक बहुत बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था बड़े पैमाने पर अपने उद्योगों का समर्थन करती है, और अन्य जगहों पर उपभोक्ताओं और श्रमिकों को अपने स्वयं के विनिर्माण आधार की रक्षा के लिए कितना भुगतान करना चाहिए।

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: सस्ते सामानों से वास्तविक लाभ और खोए हुए कारखानों से वास्तविक लागत होती है, और नीति को दोनों को तौलना होगा।

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: पाठकों के लिए, सबसे व्यावहारिक निष्कर्ष यह है कि स्टील-आधारित सामानों, सौर प्रतिष्ठानों, वाहनों और बैटरियों की कीमतें, साथ ही विनिर्माण क्षेत्रों में नौकरियां, इस बात से आकार लेने की संभावना है कि यह बातचीत कैसे सामने आती है।

es.title: Demasiado acero, demasiados paneles: por qué EE. UU. está reuniendo a sus aliados contra la sobrecapacidad de China

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: Washington ha convocado conversaciones con 14 países sobre la capacidad industrial excesiva, y Pekín ha respondido públicamente.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: La reunión es la señal más reciente de que la sobrecapacidad, que alguna vez fue un término comercial de nicho, se ha convertido en un tema central en la forma en que las grandes economías interactúan entre sí.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: Esto es lo qué significa la palabra, qué industrias están más expuestas y cómo la disputa podría afectar los precios y los empleos a nivel nacional.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Este artículo es únicamente para información general y no constituye asesoramiento de inversión, legal o financiero.

segments.src: Details of the talks may change as the situation develops.*
segments.tr: Los detalles de las conversaciones pueden cambiar a medida que se desarrolle la situación.*

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## Lo que realmente significa "sobrecapacidad"

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: Existe sobrecapacidad cuando las fábricas pueden producir mucho más de lo que el mercado está dispuesto a comprar a un precio rentable.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: En un mercado normal, esa brecha se cierra con la caída de los precios, la reducción de los beneficios y, finalmente, el cierre de plantas o fusiones.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: El argumento de EE. UU. es que esta corrección no ocurre de la manera habitual en China.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios en Washington y en varias capitales aliadas afirman que el apoyo gubernamental, que incluye créditos baratos, terrenos y energía subsidiados, e incentivos de los gobiernos locales para mantener las fábricas funcionando, permite a los productores seguir expandiéndose incluso cuando la demanda es baja.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: El excedente fluye entonces hacia los mercados de exportación a precios bajos.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: China rechaza ese enfoque.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios chinos argumentan que sus fabricantes son competitivos debido a la escala, la profundidad de la cadena de suministro y la tecnología, y no debido a ayudas desleales.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: También señalan que la demanda de tecnología ecológica en todo el mundo está creciendo y que los productos chinos baratos han ayudado a los consumidores y acelerado la transición energética.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: Muchos economistas se sitúan entre ambas posturas: los subsidios son reales y cuantiosos, pero también lo es la eficiencia manufacturera china.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## Por qué el argumento cobra fuerza ahora

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: Varias tendencias han convergido:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **Débil demanda interna en China.** Una prolongada crisis inmobiliaria ha reducido la demanda de acero, cemento y vidrio a nivel nacional, lo que obliga a los productores a buscar mercados en el exterior.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **Fuerte inversión en manufactura.** El capital ha fluido hacia vehículos eléctricos, baterías y equipos solares, a menudo más rápido de lo que ha crecido la demanda global.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **Caída de los precios globales.** En varios sectores, los precios de exportación han disminuido drásticamente, presionando a los productores en Europa, Norteamérica, India y el Sudeste Asiático.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **Frustración compartida.** Los gobiernos que no están de acuerdo en muchas cosas ahora encuentran puntos en común en esta, razón por la cual una reunión multinacional es posible en absoluto.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## Las industrias más expuestas

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **Acero y aluminio.** China produce aproximadamente la mitad del acero del mundo, mucho más que cualquier otro país.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: Incluso cuando las exportaciones de China representan una proporción modesta de su producción, son grandes en relación con el comercio de acero de otros mercados.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: Los productores en Europa, Japón, Corea del Sud, India y EE. UU. han presionado a sus gobiernos en busca de protección.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **Paneles solares.** Las empresas chinas dominan casi todas las etapas de la cadena de suministro solar, desde el polisilicio hasta los módulos terminados.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: La capacidad de fabricación global está muy por encima de las instalaciones anuales y los precios de los paneles han caído a mínimos históricos.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: Eso es una buena noticia para los instaladores y compradores, pero ha llevado a muchos fabricantes fuera de China a registrar pérdidas o a la bancarrota.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **Vehículos eléctricos y baterías.** Los fabricantes de automóviles chinos se han expandido rápidamente, y EE. UU. y la UE han respondido con aranceles e investigaciones.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: Los fabricantes de baterías enfrentan la misma presión, ya que la capacidad ha crecido más rápido que los pedidos.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **Productos químicos, vidrio y otros materiales básicos.** Estos sectores son menos visibles para los consumidores, pero suministran a muchas otras industrias, y las fluctuaciones de precios en ellos pueden repercutir en toda la economía.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## Lo que podría significar para los precios

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Para los hogares, el panorama es mixto.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **Las importaciones más baratas ayudan a los consumidores.** Los paneles, baterías, electrodomésticos y vehículos de menor precio reducen los costos para los compradores y pueden acelerar la adopción de energía limpia.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **Las barreras comerciales pueden encarecer los costos.** Si EE. UU. y sus socios responden con aranceles más altos, cuotas u otras restricciones, parte de esa ventaja de costos desaparece. Los aranceles pasados sobre el acero, el aluminio y ciertos productos chinos han sido pagados en parte por las empresas nacionales y, indirectamente, por los consumidores.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **La represalia es posible.** China ha respondido previamente a las medidas comerciales con controles a la exportación de materiales como tierras raras y minerales críticos, y con sus propios aranceles a los productos estadounidenses, incluidos los productos agrícolas. Eso podría afectar a los fabricantes que dependen de esos insumos y a los agricultores que confían en los compradores chinos.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **La seguridad de la cadena de suministro tiene un precio.** Construir más capacidad en el país o en países aliados generalmente cuesta más que comprar al productor de menor costo. Los defensores dicen que esa prima compra resiliencia; los críticos dicen que es un impuesto oculto.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## Lo que podría significar para el empleo

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: El efecto sobre el empleo depende en gran medida de dónde vivas y a qué te dediques.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **Las industrias protegidas pueden ganar.** Los trabajadores del acero, los empleados de las fundiciones de aluminio y los trabajadores en plantas nacionales de energía solar y baterías se beneficiarán si la presión de las importaciones disminuye.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **Las industrias secundarias pueden perder.** Los fabricantes, constructores e instaladores que compran esos materiales pueden enfrentar mayores costos de insumos, lo que puede reducir la contratación o la inversión.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **Los exportadores corren el riesgo de represalias.** Las granjas, los fabricantes de aviones y otros exportadores pueden verse afectados si los socios comerciales toman represalias.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **Los efectos locales son los que más importan.** Los cierres de plantas golpean duramente a ciudades específicas, mientras que los beneficios de las importaciones baratas se distribuyen escasamente entre millones de compradores. Este desequilibrio es una gran razón por la cual el tema tiene tanto peso político.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Qué observar a continuación

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Si las conversaciones producen acciones concretas.** Una declaración compartida es una cosa; aranceles coordinados, normas comunes de defensa comercial o investigaciones conjuntas serían otra.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Cómo los aliados equilibran sus propios intereses.** Muchos de los países invitados a conversar también comercian intensamente con China y es posible que no quieran tomar partido.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **La respuesta de China.** Pekín puede ofrecer concesiones limitadas, como disciplina de producción en ciertos sectores, o puede responder con contramedidas.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Normas a nivel global.** Las disputas sobre subsidios y distorsiones del mercado a menudo terminan en la Organización Mundial del Comercio, aunque su sistema de resolución de disputas se ha debilitado en los últimos años.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: La disputa sobre la sobrecapacidad va más allá del acero y los paneles solares.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: Es un debate sobre cómo deben funcionar los mercados abiertos cuando una economía muy grande apoya a sus industrias a gran escala, y cuánto deben pagar los consumidores y trabajadores en otros lugares para proteger su propia base manufacturera.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Hay beneficios reales derivados de los productos baratos y costos reales derivados de las fábricas perdidas, y la política tendrá que sopesar ambos.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Para los lectores, la conclusión más práctica es que es probable que los precios de los bienes basados en acero, las instalaciones solares, los vehículos y las baterías, así como los empleos en las regiones manufactureras, estén determinados por cómo se desarrolle esta negociación.

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## ما تعنيه "الطاقة الإنتاجية الزائدة" في الواقع

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: توجد الطاقة الإنتاجية الزائدة عندما تستطيع المصانع إنتاج أكثر بكثير مما يستميله السوق للشراء بسعر مربح.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: في السوق الطبيعي، يتم سد هذه الفجوة من خلال انخفاض الأسعار، وانكماش الأرباح، وفي النهاية إغلاق المصانع أو عمليات الاندماج.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: حجة الولايات المتحدة هي أن هذا التصحيح لا يحدث بالطريقة المعتادة في الصين.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: يقول المسؤولون في واشنطن والعديد من العواصم الحليفة إن الدعم الحكومي، بما في ذلك الائتمان الرخيص، والأراضي والطاقة المدعومة، وحوافز الحكومة المحلية للحفاظ على عمل المصانع، يسمح للمنتجين بمواصلة التوسع حتى عندما يكون الطلب ضعيفاً.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: ثم يتدفق الفائض إلى الأسعار التصديرية بأسعار منخفضة.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: ترفض الصين هذا التوصيف.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: يجادل المسؤولون الصينيون بأن مصنعيهم تنافسيون بسبب الحجم، وعمق سلسلة التوريد، والتكنولوجيا، وليس بسبب المساعدة غير العادلة.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: ويشيرون أيضاً إلى أن الطلب على التكنولوجيا الخضراء في جميع أنحاء العالم في نمو، وأن المنتجات الصينية الرخيصة ساعدت المستهلكين وأسرعت انتقال الطاقة.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: يقف العديد من الاقتصاديين بين الرأيين: الإعانات حقيقية وكبيرة، ولكن كفاءة التصنيع الصينية كذلك أيضا.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## لماذا تبرز الحجة الآن

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: لقد اجتمعت عدة اتجاهات:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **ضعف الطلب المحلي في الصين.** أدى الركود العقاري الطويل إلى تقليل الطلب على الصلب والأسمنت والزجاج في الداخل، مما ترك المنتجين يتطلعون إلى الخارج.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **الاستثمار الكثيف في التصنيع.** تدفق رأس المال إلى المركبات الكهربائية، والبطاريات، ومعدات الطاقة الشمسية، غالباً بشكل أسرع من نمو الطلب العالمي.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **انخفاض الأسعار العالمية.** في عدة قطاعات، انخفضت أسعار التصدير بشكل حاد، مما أدى إلى الضغط على المنتجين في أوروبا وأمريكا الشمالية والهند وجنوب شرق آسيا.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **الإحباط المشترك.** الحكومات التي تختلف في أمور كثيرة تجد الآن أرضية مشتركة بشأن هذه القضية، ولهذا السبب فإن عقد اجتماع متعدد الدول ممكن على الإطلاق.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## الصناعات الأكثر عرضة للخطر

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **الصلب والألومنيوم.** تنتج الصين تقريباً نصف صلّب العالم، وهو أكثر بكثير من أي دولة أخرى.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: حتى عندما تكون صادرات الصين حصة متواضعة من إنتاجها، فهي كبيرة بالنسبة لتجارة الصلب في الأسواق الأخرى.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: ضغط المنتجون في أوروبا واليابان وكوريا الجنوبية والهند والولايات المتحدة على حكوماتهم لحمايتهم.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **الألواح الشمسية.** تهيمن الشركات الصينية على جميع مراحل سلسلة توريد الطاقة الشمسية تقريباً، من البولي سيليكون إلى الوحدات النهائية.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: الطاقة الإنتاجية العالمية أعلى بكثير من التركيبات السنوية، وانخفضت أسعار الألواح إلى مستويات تاريخية منخفضة.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: هذه أخبار سارة للمثبتين والمشترين، لكنها دفعت العديد من المصنعين خارج الصين إلى الخسائر أو الإفلاس.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **المركبات الكهربائية والبطاريات.** توسعت شركات صناعة السيارات الصينية بسرعة، واستجابت الولايات المتحدة والاتحاد الأوروبي بالتعريفات الجمركية والتحقيقات.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: تواجه شركات تصنيع البطاريات نفس الضغط، حيث نمت الطاقة الإنتاجية بشكل أسرع من الطلبات.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **المواد الكيميائية والزجاج والمواد الأساسية الأخرى.** هذه القطاعات أقل وضوحاً للمستهلكين، لكنها تورّد للعديد من الصناعات الأخرى، ويمكن أن تنتشر تقلبات الأسعار فيها عبر الاقتصاد.

fr.title: Trop d'acier, trop de panneaux : pourquoi les États-Unis rallient leurs alliés contre la surcapacité de la Chine

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: Washington a convoqué des discussions avec 14 pays sur la surcapacité industrielle, et Pékin a publiquement exprimé son désaccord.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: Cette réunion est le dernier signe que la surcapacité, autrefois un terme commercial de niche, est devenue une question centrale dans la manière dont les grandes économies traitent les unes avec les autres.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: Voici ce que signifie ce mot, quelles industries sont les plus exposées, et comment le différend pourrait affecter les prix et les emplois dans le pays.

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## Ce que signifie réellement la « surcapacité »

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: La surcapacité existe lorsque les usines peuvent produire bien plus que ce que le marché est prêt à acheter à un prix rentable.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: Dans un marché normal, cet écart est comblé par une baisse des prix, une réduction des bénéfices et, finalement, des fermetures d'usines ou des fusions.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: L'argument des États-Unis est que cette correction ne se produit pas de la manière habituelle en Chine.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: Les responsables à Washington et dans plusieurs capitales alliées affirment que le soutien du gouvernement, notamment par le biais de crédits bon marché, de terrains et d'énergie subventionnés, et d'incitations des gouvernements locaux à maintenir les usines en activité, permet aux producteurs de continuer à se développer même lorsque la demande est faible.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: L'excédent se déverse ensuite sur les marchés d'exportation à bas prix.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: La Chine rejette ce cadre.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: Les responsables chinois soutiennent que leurs fabricants sont compétitifs grâce à leur échelle, à la profondeur de leur chaîne d'approvisionnement et à leur technologie, et non grâce à une aide déloyale.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: Ils notent également que la demande mondiale en technologies vertes augmente et que les produits chinois bon marché ont aidé les consommateurs et accéléré la transition énergétique.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: De nombreux économistes se situent entre ces deux points de vue : les subventions sont réelles et importantes, mais l'efficacité manufacturière chinoise l'est tout autant.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi l'argument fait mouche maintenant

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: Plusieurs tendances se sont conjuguées :

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **Une faible demande intérieure en Chine.** Un long ralentissement du secteur immobilier a réduit la demande d'acier, de ciment et de verre dans le pays, poussant les producteurs à se tourner vers l'étranger.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **Des investissements massifs dans l'industrie manufacturière.** Les capitaux ont afflué vers les véhicules électriques, les batteries et les équipements solaires, souvent plus rapidement que la croissance de la demande mondiale.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **La chute des prix mondiaux.** Dans plusieurs secteurs, les prix à l'exportation ont fortement baissé, mettant sous pression les producteurs en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Inde et en Asie du Sud-Est.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **Une frustration partagée.** Les gouvernements qui sont en désaccord sur de nombreux points trouvent désormais un terrain d'entente sur celui-ci, ce qui explique pourquoi une réunion multinationale est possible.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## Les industries les plus exposées

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **Acier et aluminium.** La Chine produit environ la moitié de l'acier mondial, bien plus que tout autre pays.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: Même lorsque les exportations de la Chine ne représentent qu'une part modeste de sa production, elles sont importantes par rapport au commerce de l'acier des autres marchés.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: Les producteurs en Europe, au Japon, en Corée du Sud, en Inde et aux États-Unis ont tous fait pression sur leurs gouvernements pour obtenir une protection.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **Panneaux solaires.** Les entreprises chinoises dominent presque toutes les étapes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement solaire, du polysilicium aux modules finis.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: La capacité de fabrication mondiale est bien supérieure aux installations annuelles, et les prix des panneaux sont tombés à des niveaux historiquement bas.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: C'est une bonne nouvelle pour les installateurs et les acheteurs, mais cela a poussé de nombreux fabricants en dehors de la Chine à subir des pertes ou à faire faillite.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **Véhicules électriques et batteries.** Les constructeurs automobiles chinois se sont développés rapidement, et les États-Unis et l'UE ont réagi avec des tarifs douaniers et des enquêtes.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: Les fabricants de batteries sont confrontés à la même pression, car la capacité a augmenté plus rapidement que les commandes.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **Produits chimiques, verre et autres matériaux de base.** Ces secteurs sont moins visibles pour les consommateurs, mais ils fournissent de nombreuses autres industries, et les fluctuations de prix dans ces domaines peuvent se répercuter sur l'ensemble de l'économie.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour les prix

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Pour les ménages, la situation est mitigée.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **Les importations moins chères aident les consommateurs.** Les panneaux, batteries, appareils électroménagers et véhicules à bas prix réduisent les coûts pour les acheteurs et peuvent accélérer l'adoption de l'énergie propre.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **Les barrières commerciales peuvent augmenter les coûts.** Si les États-Unis et leurs partenaires réagissent avec des tarifs douaniers plus élevés, des quotas ou d'autres restrictions, une partie de cet avantage de coût disparaît. Les tarifs passés sur l'acier, l'aluminium et certains produits chinois ont été payés en partie par les entreprises nationales et, indirectement, par les consommateurs.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **Des représailles sont possibles.** La Chine a déjà répondu aux mesures commerciales par des contrôles à l'exportation sur des matériaux tels que les terres rares et les minéraux critiques, et par ses propres tarifs sur les produits américains, y compris les produits agricoles. Cela pourrait affecter les fabricants qui dépendent de ces intrants et les agriculteurs qui comptent sur les acheteurs chinois.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **La sécurité de la chaîne d'approvisionnement a un prix.** Construire plus de capacité chez soi ou dans des pays alliés coûte généralement plus cher que d'acheter auprès du producteur le moins cher. Les partisans disent que cette prime achète de la résilience ; les critiques disent qu'il s'agit d'une taxe cachée.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela pourrait signifier pour l'emploi

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: L'effet sur l'emploi dépend fortement de l'endroit où vous vivez et de ce que vous faites.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **Les industries protégées peuvent y gagner.** Les travailleurs de l'acier, les employés des fonderies d'aluminium et les travailleurs des usines nationales de panneaux solaires et de batteries pourraient bénéficier d'une atténuation de la pression des importations.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **Les industries en aval peuvent y perdre.** Les fabricants, les constructeurs et les installateurs qui achètent ces matériaux peuvent être confrontés à des coûts d'intrants plus élevés, ce qui peut réduire les embauches ou les investissements.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **Les exportateurs portent le risque de représailles.** Les fermes, les fabricants d'avions et d'autres exportateurs peuvent être touchés si les partenaires commerciaux exercent des représailles.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **Les effets locaux sont les plus importants.** Les fermetures d'usines frappent durement des villes spécifiques, tandis que les avantages des importations bon marché sont répartis de manière diffuse sur des millions d'acheteurs. Ce déséquilibre est une raison majeure pour laquelle la question est politiquement puissante.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller ensuite

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Si les discussions débouchent sur des actions concrètes.** Une déclaration commune est une chose ; des tarifs coordonnés, des règles de défense commerciale communes ou des enquêtes conjointes en seraient une autre.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Comment les alliés équilibrent leurs propres intérêts.** Beaucoup de pays invités à discuter commercent également beaucoup avec la Chine et pourraient ne pas vouloir choisir leur camp.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **La réponse de la Chine.** Pékin pourrait offrir des concessions limitées, telles qu'une discipline de production dans certains secteurs, ou répondre par des contre-mesures.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Les règles au niveau mondial.** Les différends sur les subventions et les distorsions de marché finissent souvent devant l'Organisation mondiale du commerce, bien que son système de règlement des différends ait été affaibli ces dernières années.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: Le différend sur la surcapacité concerne bien plus que l'acier et les panneaux solaires.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: C'est un débat sur la manière dont les marchés ouverts doivent fonctionner lorsqu'une très grande économie soutient ses industries à une échelle massive, et sur le prix que les consommateurs et les travailleurs ailleurs devraient payer pour protéger leur propre base manufacturière.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Il y a des gains réels grâce aux produits bon marché et des coûts réels dus à la perte d'usines, et la politique devra peser les deux.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs, le point le plus pratique à retenir est que les prix des produits à base d'acier, des installations solaires, des véhicules et des batteries, ainsi que les emplois dans les régions manufacturières, seront probablement façonnés par la manière dont cette négociation se déroulera.
