segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **As indústrias a jusante podem perder.** Fabricantes, construtores e instaladores que compram esses materiais podem enfrentar custos de insumos mais altos, o que pode reduzir a contratação ou o investimento.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **Os exportadores carregam o risco de retaliação.** Fazendas, fabricantes de aeronaves e outros exportadores podem ser atingidos se os parceiros comerciais retaliarem.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **Os efeitos locais importam mais.** O fechamento de fábricas atinge duramente cidades específicas, enquanto os benefícios das importações baratas são distribuídos de forma tênue entre milhões de compradores. Esse desequilíbrio é uma grande razão pela qual a questão é politicamente poderosa.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Se as conversas produzirem ação concreta.** Uma declaração compartilhada é uma coisa; tarifas coordenadas, regras comuns de defesa comercial ou investigações conjuntas seriam outra.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Como os aliados equilibram seus próprios interesses.** Muitos dos países convidados a conversar também negociam pesadamente com a China e podem não querer escolher lados.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **A resposta da China.** Pequim pode oferecer concessões limitadas, como disciplina de produção em certos setores, ou pode responder com contramedidas.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Regras em nível global.** Disputas sobre subsídios e distorções de mercado muitas vezes acabam na Organização Mundial do Comércio, embora seu sistema de solução de controvérsias tenha sido enfraquecido nos últimos anos.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## O resultado final

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: A disputa sobre a supercapacidade vai além do aço e dos painéis solares.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: É um debate sobre como os mercados abertos devem funcionar quando uma economia muito grande apoia suas indústrias em escala massiva, e quanto os consumidores e trabalhadores em outros lugares devem pagar para proteger sua própria base de manufatura.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Há ganhos reais com bens baratos e custos reais com fábricas perdidas, e a política terá que ponderar ambos.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Para os leitores, a conclusão mais prática é que os preços de produtos à base de aço, instalações solares, veículos e baterias, bem como os empregos nas regiões industriais, provavelmente serão moldados por como essa negociação se desenrolará.

in.title: Terlalu Banyak Baja, Terlalu Banyak Panel: Mengapa AS Menggalang Sekutu Melawan Kelebihan Kapasitas Tiongkok

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: Washington telah mengadakan pembicaraan dengan 14 negara mengenai kelebihan kapasitas industri, dan Beijing telah menanggapi secara terbuka.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: Pertemuan ini adalah tanda terbaru bahwa kelebihan kapasitas, yang dulunya merupakan istilah perdagangan khusus, telah menjadi isu utama dalam cara ekonomi-ekonomi besar berurusan satu sama lain.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah arti dari kata tersebut, industri mana yang paling terdampak, dan bagaimana perselisihan ini dapat memengaruhi harga dan lapangan kerja di dalam negeri.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum dan bukan merupakan saran investasi, hukum, atau keuangan.

segments.src: Details of the talks may change as the situation develops.*
segments.tr: Detail pembicaraan dapat berubah seiring perkembangan situasi.*

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## Apa arti "kelebihan kapasitas" sebenarnya

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: Kelebihan kapasitas terjadi ketika pabrik dapat memproduksi jauh lebih banyak daripada yang ingin dibeli pasar dengan harga yang menguntungkan.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: Di pasar normal, kesenjangan itu ditutup oleh penurunan harga, penyusutan keuntungan, dan pada akhirnya penutupan pabrik atau merger.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: Argumen AS adalah bahwa koreksi ini tidak terjadi dengan cara yang biasa di Tiongkok.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: Para pejabat di Washington dan beberapa ibu kota sekutu mengatakan bahwa dukungan pemerintah, termasuk kredit murah, subsidi lahan dan energi, serta insentif pemerintah daerah untuk menjaga pabrik tetap beroperasi, memungkinkan produsen untuk terus berekspansi bahkan ketika permintaan lemah.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: Surplus tersebut kemudian mengalir ke pasar ekspor dengan harga rendah.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: Tiongkok menolak kerangka berpikir tersebut.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: Pejabat Tiongkok berpendapat bahwa produsen mereka kompetitif karena skala, kedalaman rantai pasokan, dan teknologi, bukan karena bantuan yang tidak adil.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: Mereka juga mencatat bahwa permintaan akan teknologi hijau di seluruh dunia sedang tumbuh, dan bahwa produk murah Tiongkok telah membantu konsumen dan mempercepat transisi energi.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: Banyak ekonom berada di antara kedua pandangan tersebut: subsidi itu nyata dan besar, tetapi efisiensi manufaktur Tiongkok juga demikian.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## Mengapa argumen ini muncul sekarang

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: Beberapa tren telah bergabung:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **Lemahnya permintaan domestik di Tiongkok.** Penurunan properti yang berkepanjangan telah mengurangi permintaan baja, semen, dan kaca di dalam negeri, sehingga produsen mencari pasar ke luar negeri.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **Investasi besar-besaran di bidang manufaktur.** Modal telah mengalir ke kendaraan listrik, baterai, dan peralatan surya, seringkali lebih cepat daripada pertumbuhan permintaan global.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **Turunnya harga global.** Di beberapa sektor, harga ekspor telah turun tajam, menekan produsen di Eropa, Amerika Utara, India, dan Asia Tenggara.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **Frustrasi bersama.** Pemerintah yang tidak setuju pada banyak hal sekarang menemukan titik temu pada isu ini, itulah sebabnya pertemuan multi-negara dimungkinkan.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## Industri yang paling terdampak

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **Baja dan aluminium.** Tiongkok memproduksi sekitar setengah dari baja dunia, jauh lebih banyak daripada negara lain mana pun.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: Bahkan ketika ekspor Tiongkok hanya merupakan bagian kecil dari produksinya, jumlahnya besar dibandingkan dengan perdagangan baja di pasar lain.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: Produsen di Eropa, Jepang, Korea Selatan, India, dan AS semuanya telah mendesak pemerintah mereka untuk memberikan perlindungan.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **Panel surya.** Perusahaan Tiongkok mendominasi hampir setiap tahap rantai pasokan surya, mulai dari polisilikon hingga modul jadi.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: Kapasitas manufaktur global jauh di atas instalasi tahunan, dan harga panel telah jatuh ke rekor terendah.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: Itu adalah kabar baik bagi pemasang dan pembeli, tetapi telah mendorong banyak produsen di luar Tiongkok mengalami kerugian atau kebangkrutan.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **Kendaraan listrik dan baterai.** Produsen mobil Tiongkok telah berekspansi dengan cepat, dan AS serta Uni Eropa telah merespons dengan tarif dan penyelidikan.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: Pembuat baterai menghadapi tekanan yang sama, karena kapasitas telah tumbuh lebih cepat daripada pesanan.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **Bahan kimia, kaca, dan bahan dasar lainnya.** Sektor-sektor ini kurang terlihat oleh konsumen, tetapi mereka memasok banyak industri lain, dan fluktuasi harga di sana dapat merembet ke seluruh ekonomi.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi harga

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Bagi rumah tangga, situasinya beragam.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **Impor yang lebih murah membantu konsumen.** Panel, baterai, peralatan, dan kendaraan dengan harga lebih rendah mengurangi biaya bagi pembeli dan dapat mempercepat adopsi energi bersih.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **Hambatan perdagangan dapat meningkatkan biaya.** Jika AS dan mitranya merespons dengan tarif, kuota, atau pembatasan lain yang lebih tinggi, sebagian dari keuntungan biaya tersebut akan hilang. Tarif masa lalu pada baja, aluminium, dan barang-barang Tiongkok tertentu telah dibayar sebagian oleh bisnis domestik dan, secara tidak langsung, oleh konsumen.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **Retaliasi dimungkinkan.** Tiongkok sebelumnya telah menanggapi tindakan perdagangan dengan kontrol ekspor pada bahan-bahan seperti tanah jarang dan mineral kritis, serta dengan tarifnya sendiri pada barang-barang AS, termasuk produk pertanian. Hal itu dapat memengaruhi produsen yang bergantung pada input tersebut dan petani yang mengandalkan pembeli Tiongkok.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **Keamanan rantai pasokan memiliki harga.** Membangun lebih banyak kapasitas di dalam negeri atau di negara sekutu biasanya memakan biaya lebih tinggi daripada membeli dari produsen dengan biaya terendah. Para pendukung mengatakan bahwa premi tersebut membeli ketahanan; para kritikus mengatakan itu adalah pajak tersembunyi.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## Apa artinya bagi lapangan kerja

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: Dampaknya terhadap lapangan kerja sangat bergantung pada tempat tinggal Anda dan apa yang Anda lakukan.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **Industri yang dilindungi mungkin diuntungkan.** Pekerja baja, karyawan peleburan aluminium, dan pekerja di pabrik surya dan baterai domestik akan diuntungkan jika tekanan impor mereda.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **Industri hilir mungkin dirugikan.** Produsen, pembangun, dan pemasang yang membeli bahan-bahan tersebut dapat menghadapi biaya input yang lebih tinggi, yang dapat mengurangi perekrutan atau investasi.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **Eksportir menanggung risiko retaliasi.** Pertanian, pembuat pesawat, dan eksportir lainnya dapat terkena dampak jika mitra dagang membalas.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **Dampak lokal paling berarti.** Penutupan pabrik memukul kota-kota tertentu dengan keras, sementara manfaat impor murah tersebar tipis di antara jutaan pembeli. Ketidakseimbangan ini adalah alasan besar mengapa isu ini memiliki kekuatan politik.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Apakah pembicaraan menghasilkan tindakan nyata.** Pernyataan bersama adalah satu hal; tarif terkoordinasi, aturan pertahanan perdagangan bersama, atau penyelidikan gabungan akan menjadi hal lain.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Bagaimana sekutu menyeimbangkan kepentingan mereka sendiri.** Banyak negara yang diundang untuk berbicara juga berdagang secara intensif dengan Tiongkok dan mungkin tidak ingin memihak.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **Respons Tiongkok.** Beijing mungkin menawarkan konsesi terbatas, seperti disiplin produksi di sektor-sektor tertentu, atau mungkin menjawab dengan tindakan balasan.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Aturan di tingkat global.** Perselisihan mengenai subsidi dan distorsi pasar sering berakhir di Organisasi Perdagangan Dunia (WTO), meskipun sistem perselisihannya telah melemah dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Kesimpulan

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: Perselisihan mengenai kelebihan kapasitas bukan hanya tentang baja dan panel surya.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: Ini adalah perdebatan tentang bagaimana pasar terbuka harus bekerja ketika ekonomi yang sangat besar mendukung industrinya dalam skala besar, dan berapa banyak yang harus dibayar oleh konsumen dan pekerja di tempat lain untuk melindungi basis manufaktur mereka sendiri.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Ada keuntungan nyata dari barang murah dan biaya nyata dari pabrik yang tutup, dan kebijakan harus mempertimbangkan keduanya.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Bagi pembaca, kesimpulan paling praktis adalah bahwa harga barang berbasis baja, instalasi surya, kendaraan, dan baterai, serta lapangan kerja di wilayah manufaktur, kemungkinan besar akan dibentuk oleh bagaimana negosiasi ini berlangsung.

segments.tr: - **世界的な価格下落。** いくつかのセクターでは輸出価格が急落しており、欧州、北米、インド、東南アジアの生産者を圧迫している。

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **共通の不満。** 多くの点で意見が合わない政府同士が、この一点においては共通の認識を持っており、それが多国間会議を可能にしている理由である。

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## 最も影響を受けている産業

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **鉄鋼およびアルミニウム。** 中国は世界の鉄鋼の約半分を生産しており、他国を大きく引き離している。

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: 中国の輸出がその生産量に占める割合が控えめな場合であっても、他の市場の鉄鋼貿易と比較するとその規模は大きい。

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: 欧州、日本、韓国、インド、米国の生産者は、こぞって自国政府に保護を求めている。

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **太陽光パネル。** 中国企業は、ポリシリコンから完成したモジュールに至るまで、太陽光発電のサプライチェーンのほぼすべての段階を支配している。

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: 世界の製造能力は年間設置量を大幅に上回っており、パネル価格は歴史的な安値まで下落している。

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: これは設置業者や購入者にとっては朗報だが、中国以外の多くの製造業者を赤字や破産に追い込んでいる。

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **電気自動車（EV）およびバッテリー。** 中国の自動車メーカーは急速に拡大しており、米国とEUは関税や調査で対抗している。

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: バッテリーメーカーも同様の圧力に直面しており、受注の伸びよりも生産能力の拡大が先行している。

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **化学製品、ガラス、その他の基礎素材。** これらのセクターは消費者からは見えにくいが、他の多くの産業に供給を行っており、そこでの価格変動は経済全体に波及する可能性がある。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## 価格への影響

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: 家計にとって、状況は複雑だ。

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **安価な輸入品は消費者を助ける。** 低価格のパネル、バッテリー、家電製品、車両は購入者のコストを削減し、クリーンエネルギーの導入を加速させる可能性がある。

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **貿易障壁はコストを上昇させる可能性がある。** 米国とそのパートナーがより高い関税、割当制、その他の制限で対応すれば、そのコスト上の利点の一部は消滅する。過去の鉄鋼、アルミニウム、特定の中国製品に対する関税は、一部が国内企業によって、間接的には消費者によって負担されてきた。

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **報復の可能性がある。** 中国は過去に、レアアースや重要鉱物などの素材に対する輸出規制や、農産物を含む米国製品への独自の関税といった貿易措置で報復してきた。これは、それらの投入物に依存する製造業者や、中国の買い手に依存する農家に影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **サプライチェーンの安全性には代償が伴う。** 国内や同盟国で生産能力を増強することは、通常、最も低コストの生産者から購入するよりも費用がかかる。支持者はそのプレミアムが回復力を買うと主張するが、批判者はそれを隠れた税金だと指摘する。

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## 雇用への影響

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: 雇用への影響は、居住地や職種に大きく依存する。

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **保護される産業は利益を得る可能性がある。** 鉄鋼労働者、アルミニウム精錬所の従業員、国内の太陽光パネルやバッテリー工場の労働者は、輸入圧力が緩和されれば恩恵を受ける可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **川下の産業は損失を被る可能性がある。** それらの素材を購入する製造業者、建設業者、設置業者は、より高い投入コストに直面する可能性があり、それが雇用や投資を減少させるかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **輸出業者は報復のリスクを負う。** 貿易相手国が報復措置に出た場合、農場、航空機メーカー、その他の輸出業者が打撃を受ける可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **地域的な影響が最も大きい。** 工場の閉鎖は特定の町に深刻な打撃を与える一方、安価な輸入品の恩恵は何百万人もの購入者に薄く広く分散される。この不均衡が、この問題が政治的に強力な理由の一つである。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 今後の注目点

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **協議が具体的な行動を生むかどうか。** 共同声明を出すことと、協調した関税、共通の貿易防衛ルール、あるいは共同調査を行うこととは別問題である。

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **同盟国が自国の利益とどうバランスを取るか。** 協議に招待された国の多くは中国とも深く貿易を行っており、どちらか一方に肩入れしたくないと考えている可能性がある。

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **中国の対応。** 北京は特定のセクターでの生産規律といった限定的な譲歩を提示するかもしれないし、対抗措置で応じるかもしれない。

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **世界レベルでのルール。** 補助金や市場の歪みをめぐる紛争は、多くの場合世界貿易機関（WTO）に持ち込まれるが、その紛争解決システムは近年弱体化している。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 結論

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: 過剰生産能力をめぐる論争は、鉄鋼や太陽光パネル以上の問題である。

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: これは、非常に巨大な経済圏が大規模に自国産業を支援している状況下で、開かれた市場がどのように機能すべきか、そして他の地域の消費者や労働者が自国の製造基盤を守るためにどれだけの代償を払うべきかという議論である。

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: 安価な商品による真の利益と、工場の閉鎖による真のコストが存在しており、政策は両者を天秤にかける必要がある。

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: 読者にとって最も実用的な教訓は、鉄鋼ベースの製品、太陽光発電設備、車両、バッテリーの価格、そして製造地域の雇用が、この交渉がどのように展開するかによって左右される可能性が高いということだ。

de.title: Zu viel Stahl, zu viele Paneele: Warum die USA Verbündete gegen Chinas Überkapazitäten mobilisieren

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: Washington hat Gespräche mit 14 Ländern über industrielle Überkapazitäten einberufen, und Peking hat öffentlich dagegen gehalten.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: Das Treffen ist das jüngste Zeichen dafür, dass Überkapazitäten, einst ein Nischenbegriff im Handel, zu einem zentralen Thema im Umgang der großen Volkswirtschaften miteinander geworden sind.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: Hier ist, was das Wort bedeutet, welche Branchen am stärksten betroffen sind und wie der Streit Preise und Arbeitsplätze im eigenen Land erreichen könnte.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Dieser Artikel dient nur zu allgemeinen Informationszwecken und stellt keine Anlage-, Rechts- oder Finanzberatung dar.

segments.src: Details of the talks may change as the situation develops.*
segments.tr: Die Details der Gespräche können sich im Laufe der Situation ändern.*

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## Was „Überkapazität“ tatsächlich bedeutet

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: Überkapazitäten liegen vor, wenn Fabriken weit mehr produzieren können, als der Markt zu einem rentablen Preis kaufen möchte.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: In einem normalen Markt wird diese Lücke durch sinkende Preise, schrumpfende Gewinne und schließlich Fabrikschließungen oder Fusionen geschlossen.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: Das Argument der USA ist, dass diese Korrektur in China nicht auf die übliche Weise stattfindet.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: Beamte in Washington und mehreren verbündeten Hauptstädten sagen, dass staatliche Unterstützung, einschließlich billiger Kredite, subventioniertem Land und Energie sowie Anreizen der Lokalregierung zur Aufrechterhaltung des Fabrikbetriebs, es den Produzenten ermöglicht, weiter zu expandieren, selbst wenn die Nachfrage schwach ist.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: Der Überschuss fließt dann zu niedrigen Preisen in die Exportmärkte.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: China weist diesen Rahmen zurück.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: Chinesische Beamte argumentieren, dass ihre Hersteller aufgrund von Skaleneffekten, der Tiefe der Lieferkette und Technologie wettbewerbsfähig sind, nicht wegen unfairen Hilfe.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: Sie stellen auch fest, dass die weltweite Nachfrage nach grüner Technologie wächst und dass billige chinesische Produkte den Verbrauchern geholfen und die Energiewende beschleunigt haben.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: Viele Ökonomen stehen zwischen den beiden Ansichten: Subventionen sind real und groß, aber das gilt auch für die Effizienz der chinesischen Fertigung.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## Warum das Argument jetzt verfängt

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: Mehrere Trends sind zusammengekommen:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **Schwache Inlandsnachfrage in China.** Ein anhaltender Immobilieneinbruch hat die Nachfrage nach Stahl, Zement und Glas im Inland verringert, so dass die Produzenten sich im Ausland umsehen müssen.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **Hohe Investitionen in die Fertigung.** Kapital ist in Elektrofahrzeuge, Batterien und Solarausrüstung geflossen, oft schneller als die globale Nachfrage gewachsen ist.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **Fallende Weltmarktpreise.** In mehreren Sektoren sind die Exportpreise stark gesunken, was die Produzenten in Europa, Nordamerika, Indien und Südostasien unter Druck setzt.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **Geteilte Frustration.** Regierungen, die sich in vielen Dingen uneinig sind, finden jetzt eine gemeinsame Basis in dieser Frage, weshalb ein Treffen vieler Länder überhaupt möglich ist.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## Die am stärksten gefährdeten Branchen

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **Stahl und Aluminium.** China produziert etwa die Hälfte des weltweiten Stahls, weit mehr als jedes andere Land.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: Selbst wenn Chinas Exporte einen bescheidenen Anteil seiner Produktion ausmachen, sind sie im Vergleich zum Stahlhandel anderer Märkte groß.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: Produzenten in Europa, Japan, Südkorea, Indien und den USA haben alle ihre Regierungen um Schutz gebeten.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **Solarmodule.** Chinesische Firmen dominieren fast jede Phase der Solar-Lieferkette, von Polysilizium bis zu fertigen Modulen.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: Die globale Produktionskapazität liegt weit über den jährlichen Installationen, und die Preise für Paneele sind auf historische Tiefststände gefallen.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: Das sind gute Nachrichten für Installateure und Käufer, aber es hat viele Hersteller außerhalb Chinas in Verluste oder den Bankrott getrieben.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **Elektrofahrzeuge und Batterien.** Chinesische Autohersteller haben schnell expandiert, und die USA und die EU haben mit Zöllen und Untersuchungen reagiert.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: Batteriehersteller stehen vor dem gleichen Druck, da die Kapazität schneller gewachsen ist als die Bestellungen.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **Chemie, Glas und andere Grundstoffe.** Diese Sektoren sind für Verbraucher weniger sichtbar, aber sie beliefern viele andere Industrien, und Preisschwankungen dort können sich durch die Wirtschaft fortpflanzen.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## Was das für die Preise bedeuten könnte

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Für Haushalte ist das Bild gemischt.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **Günstigere Importe helfen den Verbrauchern.** Günstigere Paneele, Batterien, Haushaltsgeräte und Fahrzeuge senken die Kosten für Käufer und können die Einführung sauberer Energie beschleunigen.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **Handelshemmnisse können die Kosten erhöhen.** Wenn die USA und ihre Partner mit höheren Zöllen, Quoten oder anderen Beschränkungen reagieren, verschwindet ein Teil dieses Kostenvorteils. Frühere Zölle auf Stahl, Aluminium und bestimmte chinesische Waren wurden teilweise von inländischen Unternehmen und indirekt von den Verbrauchern bezahlt.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **Vergeltung ist möglich.** China hat zuvor auf Handelsmaßnahmen mit Exportkontrollen für Materialien wie Seltene Erden und kritische Mineralien sowie mit eigenen Zöllen auf US-Waren, einschließlich landwirtschaftlicher Produkte, reagiert. Das könnte Hersteller treffen, die von diesen Vorleistungen abhängen, und Landwirte, die auf chinesische Käufer angewiesen sind.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **Die Sicherheit der Lieferkette hat ihren Preis.** Mehr Kapazitäten im Inland oder in verbündeten Ländern aufzubauen kostet in der Regel mehr als der Kauf beim günstigsten Produzenten. Befürworter sagen, dass diese Prämie Widerstandsfähigkeit erkauft; Kritiker sagen, es sei eine versteckte Steuer.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## Was das für Arbeitsplätze bedeuten könnte

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: Die Auswirkungen auf die Beschäftigung hängen stark davon ab, wo man lebt und was man tut.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: **Geschützte Branchen könnten gewinnen.** Stahlarbeiter, Beschäftigte in Aluminiumhütten und Arbeiter in heimischen Solar- und Batteriewerken könnten profitieren, wenn der Importdruck nachlässt.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: **Nachgelagerte Industrien könnten verlieren.** Hersteller, Bauherren und Installateure, die diese Materialien kaufen, können mit höheren Vorleistungskosten konfrontiert werden, was Neueinstellungen oder Investitionen verringern kann.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: **Exporteure tragen das Vergeltungsrisiko.** Landwirtschaftsbetriebe, Flugzeughersteller und andere Exporteure können getroffen werden, wenn Handelspartner Vergeltung üben.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: **Lokale Auswirkungen sind am wichtigsten.** Fabrikschließungen treffen bestimmte Städte hart, während die Vorteile billiger Importe dünn über Millionen von Käufern verteilt sind. Dieses Ungleichgewicht ist ein Hauptgrund dafür, dass das Thema politisch so mächtig ist.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Worauf man als Nächstes achten sollte

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Ob die Gespräche konkrete Maßnahmen hervorbringen.** Eine gemeinsame Erklärung ist das eine; koordinierte Zölle, gemeinsame Handelsschutzregeln oder gemeinsame Untersuchungen wären etwas anderes.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Wie Verbündete ihre eigenen Interessen ausgleichen.** Viele der eingeladenen Länder handeln ebenfalls intensiv mit China und möchten vielleicht keine Partei ergreifen.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **Chinas Reaktion.** Peking könnte begrenzte Zugeständnisse anbieten, wie etwa Produktionsdisziplin in bestimmten Sektoren, oder es könnte mit Gegenmaßnahmen antworten.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Regeln auf globaler Ebene.** Streitigkeiten über Subventionen und Marktverzerrungen landen oft in der Welthandelsorganisation, obwohl deren Streitschlichtungssystem in den letzten Jahren geschwächt wurde.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: Der Streit über Überkapazitäten geht um mehr als nur Stahl und Solarmodule.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: Es ist eine Debatte darüber, wie offene Märkte funktionieren sollten, wenn eine sehr große Wirtschaft ihre Industrien in massivem Ausmaß unterstützt, und wie viel Verbraucher und Arbeiter anderswo bezahlen sollten, um ihre eigene Fertigungsbasis zu schützen.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Es gibt reale Gewinne aus billigen Gütern und reale Kosten durch verlorene Fabriken, und die Politik wird beides abwägen müssen.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Für die Leser ist die praktischste Erkenntnis, dass die Preise für stahlbasierte Güter, Solaranlagen, Fahrzeuge und Batterien sowie Arbeitsplätze in Fertigungsregionen wahrscheinlich davon geprägt werden, wie sich diese Verhandlung entwickelt.

vi.title: Quá nhiều thép, quá nhiều tấm pin: Lý do Mỹ đang tập hợp các đồng minh chống lại tình trạng dư thừa công suất của Trung Quốc

segments.src: Washington has convened talks with 14 countries on industrial excess capacity, and Beijing has pushed back publicly.
segments.tr: Washington đã triệu tập các cuộc đàm phán với 14 quốc gia về dư thừa công suất công nghiệp, và Bắc Kinh đã phản ứng công khai.

segments.src: The meeting is the latest sign that overcapacity, once a niche trade term, has become a central issue in how major economies deal with one another.
segments.tr: Cuộc gặp là dấu hiệu mới nhất cho thấy tình trạng dư thừa công suất, từng là một thuật ngữ thương mại ngách, đã trở thành vấn đề trung tâm trong cách các nền kinh tế lớn đối phó với nhau.

segments.src: Here is what the word means, which industries are most exposed, and how the dispute could reach prices and jobs at home.
segments.tr: Dưới đây là ý nghĩa của từ này, những ngành nào chịu ảnh hưởng nhiều nhất, và tranh chấp này có thể tác động đến giá cả và việc làm trong nước như thế nào.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only and is not investment, legal, or financial advice.
segments.tr: *Bài viết này chỉ mang tính chất thông tin chung và không phải là lời khuyên đầu tư, pháp lý hoặc tài chính.

segments.src: Details of the talks may change as the situation develops.*
segments.tr: Chi tiết về các cuộc đàm phán có thể thay đổi khi tình hình phát triển.*

segments.src: ## What "overcapacity" actually means
segments.tr: ## "Dư thừa công suất" thực sự có nghĩa là gì

segments.src: Overcapacity exists when factories can produce far more than the market is willing to buy at a profitable price.
segments.tr: Dư thừa công suất xảy ra khi các nhà máy có thể sản xuất vượt xa mức mà thị trường sẵn sàng mua ở mức giá có lãi.

segments.src: In a normal market, that gap is closed by falling prices, shrinking profits, and eventually plant closures or mergers.
segments.tr: Trong một thị trường bình thường, khoảng cách đó được thu hẹp bởi giá giảm, lợi nhuận thu hẹp, và cuối cùng là đóng cửa nhà máy hoặc sáp nhập.

segments.src: The US argument is that this correction does not happen the usual way in China.
segments.tr: Lập luận của Mỹ là sự điều chỉnh này không diễn ra theo cách thông thường ở Trung Quốc.

segments.src: Officials in Washington and several allied capitals say that government support, including cheap credit, subsidized land and energy, and local-government incentives to keep factories running, allows producers to keep expanding even when demand is soft.
segments.tr: Các quan chức ở Washington và một số thủ đô đồng minh cho biết sự hỗ trợ của chính phủ, bao gồm tín dụng giá rẻ, đất đai và năng lượng được trợ giá, và các ưu đãi của chính quyền địa phương nhằm duy trì hoạt động của các nhà máy, cho phép các nhà sản xuất tiếp tục mở rộng ngay cả khi nhu cầu yếu.

segments.src: The surplus then flows into export markets at low prices.
segments.tr: Lượng dư thừa sau đó chảy vào các thị trường xuất khẩu với giá thấp.

segments.src: China rejects that framing.
segments.tr: Trung Quốc bác bỏ cách đóng khung đó.

segments.src: Chinese officials argue that their manufacturers are competitive because of scale, supply-chain depth, and technology, not because of unfair help.
segments.tr: Các quan chức Trung Quốc lập luận rằng các nhà sản xuất của họ cạnh tranh được là nhờ quy mô, chiều sâu chuỗi cung ứng và công nghệ, chứ không phải nhờ sự trợ giúp bất công.

segments.src: They also note that the demand for green technology worldwide is growing, and that cheap Chinese products have helped consumers and speeded up the energy transition.
segments.tr: Họ cũng lưu ý rằng nhu cầu về công nghệ xanh trên toàn thế giới đang tăng lên, và các sản phẩm giá rẻ của Trung Quốc đã giúp người tiêu dùng và đẩy nhanh quá trình chuyển đổi năng lượng.

segments.src: Many economists sit between the two views: subsidies are real and large, but so is Chinese manufacturing efficiency.
segments.tr: Nhiều nhà kinh tế đứng ở giữa hai quan điểm: trợ cấp là có thật và lớn, nhưng hiệu quả sản xuất của Trung Quốc cũng vậy.

segments.src: ## Why the argument is landing now
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lập luận này lại xuất hiện lúc này

segments.src: Several trends have come together:
segments.tr: Một số xu hướng đã hội tụ:

segments.src: - **Weak domestic demand in China.** A long property slump has reduced demand for steel, cement, and glass at home, leaving producers to look abroad.
segments.tr: - **Nhu cầu nội địa yếu ở Trung Quốc.** Tình trạng sụt giảm bất động sản kéo dài đã làm giảm nhu cầu đối với thép, xi măng và kính trong nước, khiến các nhà sản xuất phải tìm kiếm thị trường nước ngoài.

segments.src: - **Heavy investment in manufacturing.** Capital has flowed into electric vehicles, batteries, and solar equipment, often faster than global demand has grown.
segments.tr: - **Đầu tư mạnh vào sản xuất.** Vốn đã đổ vào xe điện, pin và thiết bị năng lượng mặt trời, thường nhanh hơn mức tăng trưởng của nhu cầu toàn cầu.

segments.src: - **Falling global prices.** In several sectors, export prices have dropped sharply, squeezing producers in Europe, North America, India, and Southeast Asia.
segments.tr: - **Giá toàn cầu giảm.** Trong một số lĩnh vực, giá xuất khẩu đã giảm mạnh, gây áp lực lên các nhà sản xuất ở châu Âu, Bắc Mỹ, Ấn Độ và Đông Nam Á.

segments.src: - **Shared frustration.** Governments that disagree on many things now find common ground on this one, which is why a multi-country meeting is possible at all.
segments.tr: - **Sự thất vọng chung.** Các chính phủ không đồng tình về nhiều thứ giờ đây lại tìm thấy tiếng nói chung về vấn đề này, đó là lý do tại sao một cuộc họp đa quốc gia có thể diễn ra.

segments.src: ## The industries most exposed
segments.tr: ## Các ngành công nghiệp chịu ảnh hưởng nhiều nhất

segments.src: **Steel and aluminum.** China produces roughly half of the world's steel, far more than any other country.
segments.tr: **Thép và nhôm.** Trung Quốc sản xuất khoảng một nửa lượng thép của thế giới, vượt xa bất kỳ quốc gia nào khác.

segments.src: Even when China's exports are a modest share of its output, they are large relative to the steel trade of other markets.
segments.tr: Ngay cả khi xuất khẩu của Trung Quốc chỉ chiếm một phần khiêm tốn trong sản lượng của nước này, chúng vẫn rất lớn so với thương mại thép của các thị trường khác.

segments.src: Producers in Europe, Japan, South Korea, India, and the US have all pressed their governments for protection.
segments.tr: Các nhà sản xuất ở châu Âu, Nhật Bản, Hàn Quốc, Ấn Độ và Mỹ đều đã gây sức ép buộc chính phủ của họ phải bảo hộ.

segments.src: **Solar panels.** Chinese firms dominate nearly every stage of the solar supply chain, from polysilicon to finished modules.
segments.tr: **Tấm pin năng lượng mặt trời.** Các công ty Trung Quốc thống trị gần như mọi giai đoạn của chuỗi cung ứng năng lượng mặt trời, từ polysilicon đến các mô-đun thành phẩm.

segments.src: Global manufacturing capacity is well above annual installations, and panel prices have fallen to historic lows.
segments.tr: Công suất sản xuất toàn cầu cao hơn nhiều so với lượng lắp đặt hàng năm, và giá tấm pin đã giảm xuống mức thấp kỷ lục.

segments.src: That is good news for installers and buyers, but it has pushed many manufacturers outside China into losses or bankruptcy.
segments.tr: Đó là tin vui cho các nhà lắp đặt và người mua, nhưng nó đã đẩy nhiều nhà sản xuất ngoài Trung Quốc vào cảnh thua lỗ hoặc phá sản.

segments.src: **Electric vehicles and batteries.** Chinese automakers have expanded quickly, and the US and EU have responded with tariffs and investigations.
segments.tr: **Xe điện và pin.** Các nhà sản xuất ô tô Trung Quốc đã mở rộng nhanh chóng, và Mỹ cùng EU đã đáp trả bằng thuế quan và các cuộc điều tra.

segments.src: Battery makers face the same pressure, as capacity has grown faster than orders.
segments.tr: Các nhà sản xuất pin phải đối mặt với áp lực tương tự, khi công suất tăng trưởng nhanh hơn đơn đặt hàng.

segments.src: **Chemicals, glass, and other basic materials.** These sectors are less visible to consumers, but they supply many other industries, and price swings there can ripple through the economy.
segments.tr: **Hóa chất, thủy tinh và các vật liệu cơ bản khác.** Các lĩnh vực này ít được người tiêu dùng chú ý hơn, nhưng chúng cung cấp cho nhiều ngành công nghiệp khác, và sự biến động giá ở đó có thể lan tỏa qua nền kinh tế.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for prices
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có ý nghĩa gì đối với giá cả

segments.src: For households, the picture is mixed.
segments.tr: Đối với các hộ gia đình, bức tranh này có tính đa chiều.

segments.src: 1. **Cheaper imports help consumers.** Lower-priced panels, batteries, appliances, and vehicles reduce costs for buyers and can speed up adoption of clean energy.
segments.tr: 1. **Hàng nhập khẩu rẻ hơn giúp ích cho người tiêu dùng.** Các tấm pin, pin lưu trữ, thiết bị gia dụng và xe hơi có giá thấp hơn làm giảm chi phí cho người mua và có thể đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng năng lượng sạch.

segments.src: 2. **Trade barriers can raise costs.** If the US and its partners respond with higher tariffs, quotas, or other restrictions, some of that cost advantage disappears. Past tariffs on steel, aluminum, and certain Chinese goods have been paid in part by domestic businesses and, indirectly, by consumers.
segments.tr: 2. **Rào cản thương mại có thể làm tăng chi phí.** Nếu Mỹ và các đối tác phản ứng bằng thuế quan cao hơn, hạn ngạch hoặc các biện pháp hạn chế khác, một phần lợi thế chi phí đó sẽ biến mất. Các mức thuế trước đây đối với thép, nhôm và một số mặt hàng của Trung Quốc đã phần nào được chi trả bởi các doanh nghiệp trong nước và, một cách gián tiếp, bởi người tiêu dùng.

segments.src: 3. **Retaliation is possible.** China has previously responded to trade measures with export controls on materials such as rare earths and critical minerals, and with its own tariffs on US goods, including agricultural products. That could affect manufacturers that depend on those inputs and farmers who rely on Chinese buyers.
segments.tr: 3. **Khả năng trả đũa là có thể xảy ra.** Trung Quốc trước đây đã phản ứng với các biện pháp thương mại bằng các biện pháp kiểm soát xuất khẩu đối với các vật liệu như đất hiếm và khoáng sản quan trọng, và bằng thuế quan của riêng mình đối với hàng hóa Mỹ, bao gồm cả các sản phẩm nông nghiệp. Điều đó có thể ảnh hưởng đến các nhà sản xuất phụ thuộc vào các đầu vào đó và nông dân phụ thuộc vào người mua Trung Quốc.

segments.src: 4. **Supply-chain security has a price.** Building more capacity at home or in allied countries usually costs more than buying from the lowest-cost producer. Supporters say that premium buys resilience; critics say it is a hidden tax.
segments.tr: 4. **An ninh chuỗi cung ứng có cái giá của nó.** Xây dựng thêm công suất trong nước hoặc ở các quốc gia đồng minh thường tốn kém hơn việc mua từ nhà sản xuất có chi phí thấp nhất. Những người ủng hộ nói rằng khoản phí cao đó mang lại sự kiên cường; những người chỉ trích nói đó là một loại thuế ẩn.

segments.src: ## What it could mean for jobs
segments.tr: ## Điều đó có ý nghĩa gì đối với việc làm

segments.src: The effect on employment depends heavily on where you live and what you do.
segments.tr: Tác động đến việc làm phụ thuộc phần lớn vào nơi bạn sống và những gì bạn làm.

segments.src: - **Protected industries may gain.** Steelworkers, aluminum smelter employees, and workers in domestic solar and battery plants stand to benefit if import pressure eases.
segments.tr: - **Các ngành công nghiệp được bảo hộ có thể đạt lợi thế.** Công nhân ngành thép, nhân viên nhà máy luyện nhôm, và công nhân trong các nhà máy sản xuất pin và năng lượng mặt trời trong nước sẽ được hưởng lợi nếu áp lực nhập khẩu giảm bớt.

segments.src: - **Downstream industries may lose.** Manufacturers, builders, and installers who buy those materials can face higher input costs, which may reduce hiring or investment.
segments.tr: - **Các ngành công nghiệp hạ nguồn có thể bị thiệt hại.** Các nhà sản xuất, thợ xây dựng và nhà lắp đặt mua các vật liệu đó có thể phải đối mặt với chi phí đầu vào cao hơn, điều này có thể làm giảm việc tuyển dụng hoặc đầu tư.

segments.src: - **Exporters carry the retaliation risk.** Farms, aircraft makers, and other exporters can be hit if trading partners retaliate.
segments.tr: - **Các nhà xuất khẩu gánh chịu rủi ro trả đũa.** Các trang trại, nhà sản xuất máy bay và các nhà xuất khẩu khác có thể bị ảnh hưởng nếu các đối tác thương mại trả đũa.

segments.src: - **Local effects matter most.** Plant closures hit specific towns hard, while the benefits of cheap imports are spread thinly across millions of buyers. This imbalance is a big reason the issue is politically powerful.
segments.tr: - **Tác động địa phương là quan trọng nhất.** Việc đóng cửa nhà máy đánh mạnh vào các thị trấn cụ thể, trong khi lợi ích của hàng nhập khẩu giá rẻ lại được phân bổ mỏng manh cho hàng triệu người mua. Sự mất cân bằng này là lý do lớn khiến vấn đề này có sức nặng chính trị.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Những điều cần theo dõi tiếp theo

segments.src: - **Whether the talks produce concrete action.** A shared statement is one thing; coordinated tariffs, common trade-defense rules, or joint investigations would be another.
segments.tr: - **Liệu các cuộc đàm phán có mang lại hành động cụ thể hay không.** Một tuyên bố chung là một chuyện; thuế quan được phối hợp, các quy tắc phòng vệ thương mại chung, hoặc các cuộc điều tra chung sẽ là chuyện khác.

segments.src: - **How allies balance their own interests.** Many of the countries invited to talk also trade heavily with China and may not want to choose sides.
segments.tr: - **Cách các đồng minh cân bằng lợi ích của chính họ.** Nhiều quốc gia được mời đàm phán cũng giao thương mạnh mẽ với Trung Quốc và có thể không muốn chọn phe.

segments.src: - **China's response.** Beijing may offer limited concessions, such as production discipline in certain sectors, or it may answer with countermeasures.
segments.tr: - **Phản ứng của Trung Quốc.** Bắc Kinh có thể đưa ra các nhượng bộ hạn chế, chẳng hạn như kỷ luật sản xuất trong một số lĩnh vực, hoặc họ có thể đáp trả bằng các biện pháp đối phó.

segments.src: - **Rules at the global level.** Disputes over subsidies and market distortions often end up in the World Trade Organization, though its dispute system has been weakened in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Các quy tắc ở cấp độ toàn cầu.** Các tranh chấp về trợ cấp và bóp méo thị trường thường kết thúc tại Tổ chức Thương mại Thế giới, mặc dù hệ thống giải quyết tranh chấp của tổ chức này đã bị suy yếu trong những năm gần đây.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: The dispute over overcapacity is about more than steel and solar panels.
segments.tr: Tranh chấp về dư thừa công suất không chỉ xoay quanh thép và các tấm pin năng lượng mặt trời.

segments.src: It is a debate about how open markets should work when a very large economy supports its industries at massive scale, and how much consumers and workers elsewhere should pay to protect their own manufacturing base.
segments.tr: Đó là một cuộc tranh luận về việc các thị trường mở nên hoạt động như thế nào khi một nền kinh tế rất lớn hỗ trợ các ngành công nghiệp của mình ở quy mô lớn, và người tiêu dùng cũng như người lao động ở nơi khác phải trả bao nhiêu để bảo vệ cơ sở sản xuất của chính họ.

segments.src: There are real gains from cheap goods and real costs from lost factories, and policy will have to weigh both.
segments.tr: Có những lợi ích thực sự từ hàng hóa giá rẻ và những tổn thất thực tế từ các nhà máy bị đóng cửa, và chính sách sẽ phải cân nhắc cả hai.

segments.src: For readers, the most practical takeaway is that prices of steel-based goods, solar installations, vehicles, and batteries, as well as jobs in manufacturing regions, are likely to be shaped by how this negotiation unfolds.
segments.tr: Đối với độc giả, bài học thiết thực nhất là giá cả của các mặt hàng làm từ thép, các hệ thống lắp đặt năng lượng mặt trời, xe hơi và pin, cũng như việc làm tại các khu vực sản xuất, có khả năng sẽ được định hình bởi cách mà cuộc đàm phán này diễn ra.
